cues.text: I woke up this morning, and something
was seriously wrong with the world.
A bird was flying *backward*.
The rain was falling up into the sky.
And my neighbor had been standing in
the exact same position for three
hours, with one leg inside a wall.
I thought I was losing my mind.
Then I tried to open my front door.
It led to the middle of the *ocean*.
I slammed it shut, opened it again, and
suddenly I was standing in a *grocery store*.
Every single item had *my face* on it.
Even the *milk*.
I decided the smartest thing to do was stay
inside and wait for reality to fix itself.
*Terrible decision*.
At exactly noon, the sky turned blue and a
giant error message appeared above the city.
*REALITY UPDATE FAILED*. *RESTARTING IN 100 DAYS*.
Then everyone *froze*.
Everyone *except me*.
I walked outside and waved my hand in front
of a *froze*n police officer. *Nothing*.
I threw a rock at a car, and the rock turned
into a *chicken* halfway through the air.
I was about to celebrate my new life as
the world's most powerful idiot when I
noticed something across the street.
A *second stickman*.
He was moving, too.
He stared directly at me, pointed toward
the sky, and mouthed three words.
You're *not real*.
Then he *disappeared*.
A *countdown* appeared above my head.
*99 days*, 23 hours, 59 minutes.
And suddenly, I had a much bigger problem
than *backward* birds and *chicken* rocks.
I had to figure out who created
this world before it *restarted*.
Because something tells me the next
update *isn't going to be pretty*.
So, *what should I do first*?
A: *Break into* the mysterious
building where the *countdown* began.
B: Find the *stickman* who said I'm *not real*.
*Choose carefully*.
We've got *100 days* to figure out
*what the hell* is happening.
